description:
**Smooth Container** is a lightweight mod that eliminates the frustrating lag spike when opening chests, hoppers, shulker boxes, and other containers. Instead of stuttering on open, the GUI renders instantly — making inventory management feel smooth and responsive.

[](https://modrinth.com/mod/smoothcontainer/versions?l=fabric)
[](https://modrinth.com/mod/smoothcontainer/versions?l=forge)
[](https://modrinth.com/mod/smoothcontainer/versions?l=neoforge)

## 📦 Installation

1. Install the correct mod loader for your Minecraft version (Fabric, Forge, or NeoForge).
2. Place `smoothcontainer.jar` into your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
3. Launch the game — no configuration or dependencies are required.

**This mod is client-side only.** It works perfectly on multiplayer servers even if the server does not have the mod installed.

## ✨ Features

- **Instant container rendering** — eliminates the 100–300ms freeze that normally occurs when opening inventories.
- **Works with all vanilla containers** — chests, hoppers, barrels, furnaces, shulker boxes, crafting tables, anvils, and more.
- **Mod container support** — compatible with most modded storage blocks that use standard GUI rendering.
- **Lightweight** — no config files, no performance overhead beyond the fix.
- **Client-side only** — works on any server without requiring server-side installation.

## 🧩 Compatibility

| Minecraft Version | Loaders Supported | Status |
|-------------------|-------------------|--------|
| 1.21.11 | Fabric | ✅ Supported |
| 1.21.1 | Fabric, NeoForge | ✅ Supported |
| 1.20.1 | Fabric, Forge | ✅ Supported |
| 26.1.2 | Fabric | ✅ Supported |

**Required dependencies:** None.

**Known incompatibilities:** None known. This mod is designed to work alongside all major optimization mods (Sodium, Lithium, etc.) and content mods.

## ❓ FAQ

**Does this need to be installed on the server?**  
No — this is a client-side only mod. It will work on any server regardless of server-side mods.

**Is this compatible with Sodium / OptiFine / Iris?**  
Yes. Smooth Container only modifies the GUI opening process and does not touch rendering pipelines or shaders.

**Does this affect gameplay or container mechanics?**  
No — it only changes how the GUI renders when opening a container. All item interactions and mechanics remain unchanged.

**I found a bug or crash, where do I report it?**  
Please report issues on the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/ModItamio/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Asmoothcontainer). Include your Minecraft version, mod loader, and a log file if possible.

## 💖 Support the Project

If you find Smooth Container useful, consider supporting development:

[](https://ko-fi.com/U2P522M1IW)
